title: Hands-on AI Cookbook Changelog
description: Latest updates from the Hands-on AI Cookbook — new content, plugins, and platform guides.

items.title: Stronger product specs, restructured coding page, and organizational workflows
items.content_html: Upgraded Vision Brief and Feature PRD skills with deeper PM rigor, restructured Agentic Coding page, and added organizational workflow lens

items.title: New Plugin: Agentic Coding
items.content_html: New plugin for AI-assisted coding workflows — define requirements with structured PRDs before you build.

items.title: Product & Engineering section, ADRs, and platform agent examples
items.content_html: New Product & Engineering section, Architecture Decision Records page, platform-specific agent examples, and fixed agentic-coding slash commands.

items.title: Portable Deconstruct Prompt and Markdown-First Registry Skills
items.content_html: Portable Deconstruct prompt for any AI chat tool and AI Registry skills updated to save markdown files instead of Notion page bodies

items.title: Portable Analyze Prompt and Cross-Platform Install Clarity
items.content_html: Portable Analyze prompt for non-skill users and cross-platform skill install consistency across framework pages

items.title: Build Phase: Autonomy Levels and Orchestration Mechanisms
items.content_html: The Build phase now uses a two-step decision model — autonomy assessment plus orchestration mechanism — replacing the old execution pattern spectrum.

items.title: AI Workflow Design Matrix, Building Block Comparison, and Framework Terminology Update
items.content_html: New AI Workflow Design Matrix defines six workflow archetypes, Building Block Comparison Matrix helps choose the right block, and framework terminology is streamlined site-wide.

items.title: Platform Getting Started Pages, Memory Building Block, and More
items.content_html: Every platform now has a Getting Started checklist, Memory joins as the 10th building block, and Product & Engineering gets an Evaluation page.

items.title: I Built an Open-Source AI Cookbook for Builders. Here's What's Inside.
items.content_html: Why I built the Hands-on AI Cookbook -- a free, open-source resource with a framework, building blocks, and ready-made tools for applied AI.

items.title: Plugin Marketplace Moved to Dedicated Repo
items.content_html: The plugin marketplace moved to a dedicated lightweight repo for faster installs in Cowork and other tools.

items.title: Orchestration patterns, new building blocks, and framework refinements
items.content_html: Agent orchestration patterns, expanded building blocks, agent programming frameworks, and framework refinements.

items.title: Slash Commands for All Plugin Skills
items.content_html: All 10 plugin skills now have slash commands — invoke any skill directly instead of relying on auto-triggering.

items.title: New Example: Content Calendar Planning
items.content_html: See what the Business-First AI Framework actually produces — a complete worked example with all three deliverables for a real content planning workflow.

items.title: Step 3 Redesigned: Skills Drive the Build
items.content_html: Step 3 — Build Workflows redesigned around skill-driven orchestration with a new Construct page, Launch Guide, and cross-platform skills standard.

items.title: Introducing the Changelog and MCP Server
items.content_html: New Changelog with RSS feed, plus a dedicated MCP server so AI assistants can search the cookbook directly.

items.title: Build Workflows v3.1, Expanded Agents Matrix, and Streamlined Architecture Decisions
items.content_html: Building Workflows v3.1 adds plan mode gate, spec approval, and reference specs. Agents matrix expanded with SDK and browser agents. Architecture decisions streamlined.

items.title: Agentic Coding Plugin: Stronger PRDs and Vision Briefs
items.content_html: Agentic Coding plugin update: PRD skill gets paired AC/user stories and scope sections; Vision Brief skill adds strategic depth with 10 questions and inline examples.
